recipes.name: Coconut Matcha Latte
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth*.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan over medium-high heat and stir continuously.
When hot, but not boiling, remove from heat and pour into your desired cups**. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * Note the dates are used to provide natural sweetness, but they also add a slight graininess to the drink. For a smoother texture, add maple syrup instead, and simply add all the ingredients straight into the saucepan . ** Boiling matcha can cause it to taste bitter.
Storage Best to enjoy this drink immediately.
